headline: OpenAI is losing its second executive this week
summary: Denise Dresser, OpenAI's chief revenue officer, is departing. She joined in December after serving as Slack's CEO. Dali Rajic from Wiz will assume her responsibilities.

headline: The Trump admin will start letting private firms launch international cyberattacks
summary: The Trump administration is launching a new program. Private firms can now perform cyberattacks against foreign criminals. These operations will be under federal control and oversight.

summary: Robot lawnmowers are finally becoming more effective. They still require supervision to prevent damage. This review highlights a trustworthy and reliable model.

headline: You can now just point at a mess and this robot vacuum will suck it up
summary: The Matic robot vacuum now features Cues for voice and gesture control. Users can speak commands directly to the vacuum. Pointing at a mess allows for instant spot-cleaning.

summary: MTG Foundations' $30 Commander precons are highly recommended. They are a must-buy for both new and experienced players. The article explains the value and excitement behind them.

summary: A multi-function power cage is available for $263.48, including shipping. It combines a squat rack, lat pull-down machine, power tower, and dip bar. This deal is perfect for a home gym setup.

summary: The UK experienced its hottest day of the year. A temperature of 38.1C was recorded in Kew Gardens. An amber extreme heat warning remains in effect for parts of England.

headline: Son of 102-year-old says father died after being 'pushed off stage'
